plans.name: Six-month Attestix Core maintenance and interoperability plan
plans.description: Proposed six-month grant budget: INR 7,20,000 for 600 hours of Python-core maintenance and release hardening at INR 1,200/hour; INR 1,80,000 for 120 hours of independent security review at INR 1,500/hour; INR 1,20,000 for 120 hours of reproducible core-verifier testing at INR 1,000/hour; INR 1,20,000 for 120 hours of API and self-hosted reference documentation at INR 1,000/hour; INR 60,000 for capped test infrastructure and release tooling; INR 1,80,000 for 120 hours of cross-runtime verifier/SDK interoperability tests at INR 1,500/hour; INR 1,20,000 for 80 hours of community reproduction sessions, contributor feedback and public quarterly updates at INR 1,500/hour. Total INR 15,00,000 and 1,160 planned labour hours. Rates and staffing are prospective assumptions, not historical expenses or contracted reviewer commitments. Months 1-2: baseline, issue triage and release matrix. Months 3-4: core-verifier hardening, independent review and cross-runtime conformance. Months 5-6: compatibility releases, documentation and public maintenance report. At least one public community engagement/update is planned per quarter. Original deliverables remain Apache-2.0. Scope, rates, milestones and partial-funding arrangements will be agreed with the funder before work begins. Acceptance evidence: versioned positive and negative verifier fixtures with expected outcomes; a compatibility matrix stating tested and unsupported combinations; tracked review findings and remediation; reference instructions reproducible on the supported environments; and two public quarterly updates.
